<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex87012023-03-0911-03-47" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (152a3-152a6)"/>
     <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4023">rgya shes rab dbang phyug</rs> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4022">'jang shag kya dpal</rs> <lb n="152a4"/> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4020">rkyel grags pa seng ge</rs> las sogs pa chen po rnams kyi zhabs kyi rdul spyi bos blangs te mang du thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol du phyin pa'i don dang | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3780">slob dpon chos mchog</rs> gis mdzad pa'i <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5594">ti ka 'thad ldan</rs> dang | <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:5597"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5551">kha che dz+nya na shri</rs>'i ti ka</rs> lasogs pa mthong ba'i don | bsams <lb n="152a5"/> pa las byung ba'i shes rab kyis legs par gtan la phab pa'i don ston par byed pa | blo la zin pa tsam gyis mkhas pa'i mchog du 'gyur zhing mkhas pa rtag tu mi nyams par byed pa'i <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:5290">ti ka chen po</rs> 'di | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4018">shag kya'i dge slong gtsang chu mig pa seng ge dpal</rs> gyis <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6173">gsang phu ne'u thog gi gtsug lag <lb n="152a6"/> khang</rs> du brtsams te <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5595"><choice><orig>ya°</orig><reg>yar</reg></choice> lungs</rs> <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5596">khra 'brug gi gtsug lag khang</rs> du yi ger bkod pa'o || rdzogs s+ho || <note type="gloss">bkra' <expan>shis so</expan></note> || || dge'o || <note type="gloss"><expan>zhus so</expan></note> ||</seg></TEI>
